title: Refactor Rust Tests to Load Data From Shared Assets
description: Refactor the Rust test code in compose/rs/lib.rs to load hardcoded test data from shared JSON asset files located in assets/compose/. All hardcoded GUIDs, design names, piece names, expected values, hash strings, glob patterns, expected counts must be loaded from asset files. The test behavior (logic, assertions, helpers) stays in Rust code - only data moves to assets.
summary:
Refactored all Rust tests in compose/rs/lib.rs to load hardcoded test data from shared JSON asset files in assets/compose/. Changes:

1. **Added `load_asset<T>` helper** - Generic JSON deserialization helper at test module top level, alongside existing `load_kit` and `load_kit_diff`.

2. **Added asset case structs** - `HashCasesAsset`, `QualitySumCasesAsset`, `FilterKitCasesAsset`, `DesignWithDiffCasesAsset`, `FindReplaceableCasesAsset` and all nested structs with `#[derive(Deserialize)]` and `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]`.

3. **Hash tests** - `test_hash_kit`: loads kit filename and expected hash from `hash.cases.compose.json`. `test_hash_kit_diff_canonical`: loads JSON string and expected hash from asset. `test_hash_kit_diff_name_only`/`test_hash_kit_diff_deterministic`: loads JSON from asset. All deterministic hash tests load design name from asset.

4. **Quality sum test** - `sum_effective_floor_area`: loads design name, quality name, expected value, and tolerance from `quality-sum.cases.compose.json`.

5. **Filter/glob tests** - All 6 filter tests load kit filenames, design names, glob patterns, and expected kit from `filter-kit.cases.compose.json`.

6. **DesignWithDiff test** - `nakagin_capsule_tower_design_with_diff`: loads diff/expected filenames and expected status counts from `design-with-diff.cases.compose.json`.

7. **FindReplaceableTypes tests** - `synthetic_selection_enforces_distinct_connectors_and_free_design_connectors`: replaced ~100 lines of inline `serde_json::json!` with `load_asset` from `synthetic-find-replaceable.kit.compose.json`, iterates over `syntheticCases` from asset. `connector_level_boundary_matching_shrinks_candidates_as_demand_grows`: loads all piece names, forbidden families, expected families from `boundaryCases` in asset. `connected_piece_yields_only_exact_design_matches`, `isolated_piece`, `capital_piece`, `multiple_selected_pieces_yield_only_exact_design_matches`, `empty_selection`: all load case data from `find-replaceable-types.cases.compose.json`.

All 71 tests pass.
